# Maddern's Place Garden & Landscaping

> Professional landscaping services across Adelaide's southern suburbs, including Hackham, Morphett Vale, Hallett Cove, Happy Valley, Noarlunga, Reynella, Seaford, and Christies Beach.

## What is Maddern's Place?

Maddern's Place Garden & Landscaping is a local landscaping business based in Hackham, South Australia. We help homeowners and property managers transform their outdoor spaces with high-quality landscaping, garden design, turf installation, retaining walls, irrigation, and lawn care services.

## Who We Help

- Homeowners wanting a complete garden or yard transformation
- People needing new turf installed (Kikuyu, Sir Walter Buffalo, and more)
- Property owners requiring retaining walls built from timber or concrete blocks
- Residents wanting a professionally designed and installed irrigation system
- Anyone looking for reliable, recurring lawn mowing and maintenance
- People needing gutter vacuum cleaning in Adelaide's southern suburbs

## Services

| Service | Description | Coverage Area |
|---|---|---|
| Landscape Design & Construction | Full outdoor transformations including design, earthworks, planting, and finishing | Adelaide south |
| Turf Installation | Supply and lay of Kikuyu, Sir Walter, and other premium turf varieties | Adelaide south |
| Retaining Walls | Timber sleeper and concrete block retaining wall construction | Adelaide south |
| Irrigation Systems | Design, install, upgrade, and repair — using Hunter MP Rotators and Bluetooth NODE timers | Adelaide south |
| Lawn Care & Mowing | Regular mowing, edging, fertilisation, and seasonal lawn treatments | Adelaide south |
| Gutter Vacuum Cleaning | Professional gutter cleaning using vacuum equipment | Adelaide south |
| Garden Design | Custom garden design from cottage style to contemporary outdoor living | Adelaide south |

## Pricing

Pricing varies by project scope. We offer free, no-obligation quotes for all services. Contact us to discuss your project.

## How It Works

1. **Consultation** — We meet on site to understand your vision, assess the space, and discuss practical solutions.
2. **Design & Quote** — We provide a clear plan and a detailed, transparent quote.
3. **We Get to Work** — Our team completes the work efficiently with clear communication throughout.
4. **Enjoy Your Garden** — Your outdoor space is handed over ready to use, with guidance on maintenance.
